entities.summary: Associação Atlética Ponte Preta, commonly referred to as Ponte Preta or just Ponte, is a Brazilian association football club based in Campinas, São Paulo state. Ponte currently plays in the Série C, the third tier of Brazilian football, as well as in the Campeonato Paulista Série A1, the top tier of the São Paulo state football league. Vila da Ponte was a freguesia of Portugal in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
